The official Lirica landing URL is not bound to a specific season and candidate paths use a bounded same-origin allowlist. Live access, per-production showtime evidence and next-season coverage remain unverified.

Festival home page lists season productions and can transition to new editions. Exact detail parsing requires local source-credited festival edition, title, composer, physical Teatro Olimpico and recital clock; not proof future seasons are published.

The official /eventi/ calendar index is year-neutral and new /evento/ detail pages can be discovered without season-specific slugs. Theatre, composer, title and date must still be checked on each new edition; no claim of future season live proof.
